strings.startup_greeting: Le système de correction de posture yoga démarre.
strings.cmd_what_pose_unknown: Je n'ai pas encore identifié la posture — donnez-moi un instant.
strings.cmd_pause: Corrections en pause. Dites reprendre quand vous êtes prêt.
strings.cmd_restart: Redémarrage du guide pour {pose_name} depuis le début.
strings.cmd_help: Vous pouvez dire : score, quelle posture, étape suivante, répéter, pause, reprendre ou recommencer.
strings.cam_too_close: Vous êtes trop près ! Reculez un peu pour que tout votre corps rentre dans le cadre.
strings.cam_too_far: Vous êtes un peu loin. Rapprochez-vous de la caméra.
strings.cam_not_centred: Déplacez-vous vers le centre du cadre.
strings.cam_sideways: Il semble que vous soyez de côté. Regardez directement la caméra.
strings.cam_ok: L'alignement de la caméra semble bon.
strings.cam_low_visibility: Certaines parties du corps ne sont pas visibles — vérifiez l'éclairage.
strings.event_hold_achieved: Excellent ! Vous avez tenu {pose_name} avec succès. Continuez à respirer et restez dans la posture.
strings.event_catching_up: Très bien ! Rattrapons maintenant — l'instructeur est en {new_pose}. Je vous guide.
strings.event_frozen: L'instructeur est passé à la suite, mais c'est bien — concentrons-nous d'abord sur {pose_name}. Montez au-dessus de {threshold} pour cent et tenez {hold_sec} secondes.
strings.score_excellent_1: Vous êtes à {score} pour cent — excellent.
strings.score_excellent_3: Plus de quatre-vingt-dix — votre corps est exactement où il doit être.
strings.score_good_1: Vous êtes à {score} pour cent — bon alignement, petits ajustements restants.
strings.score_good_3: Bien à {score} — juste un peu plus à affiner.
strings.score_fair_2: À {score} pour cent — continuez à travailler les corrections.
strings.score_fair_3: {score} pour cent. Restez concentré et continuez à respirer.
strings.score_needs_work_2: Vous êtes à {score} pour cent. Pas de précipitation — continuez à ajuster.
strings.score_needs_work_3: {score} pour cent — travaillez articulation par articulation.
strings.well_done_2: Oui ! C'est la forme. Restez avec ça.
strings.well_done_4: Parfait — vous l'avez trouvé. Ne bougez pas.
strings.well_done_7: Vous correspondez bien à l'instructeur. Maintenez.
strings.well_done_8: Dans le mille. Ressentez cet alignement.
strings.enc_medium_1: Vous vous en sortez bien — continuez à ajuster.
strings.enc_large_1: Prenez votre temps — ça vient avec la pratique.
strings.enc_large_3: Chaque corps est différent — faites ce que vous pouvez.
strings.summary_no_attempts: Votre séance est terminée. Je n'ai enregistré aucune tentative complète cette fois. Bon effort quand même !
strings.summary_opening_with_time: Super séance ! Vous avez pratiqué pendant environ {minutes} {minute_word}.
strings.summary_all_held: Vous avez tenu avec succès chaque posture — {names}. Fantastique !
strings.summary_some_held: Vous avez tenu avec succès {held} postures sur {total} : {names}.
strings.summary_missed_singular: La posture à continuer à travailler est {names}. Votre meilleur score était : {scores}. Vous y arriverez avec un peu plus de pratique !
strings.summary_missed_plural: Les postures à continuer à travailler sont {names}. Vos meilleurs scores étaient : {scores}. Vous y arriverez !
strings.summary_closer_1: Rappelez-vous, chaque pratique compte — à bientôt sur le tapis !
strings.summary_closer_2: La régularité est la clé du progrès. Continuez !
strings.summary_closer_3: Chaque séance vous rend plus fort. Bien joué aujourd'hui !
strings.summary_closer_4: Prenez un moment pour respirer et célébrer votre effort d'aujourd'hui.
strings.cam_cant_see: Je ne vous vois pas. Placez-vous devant la caméra dans un espace bien éclairé.
strings.cam_parts_missing: Certaines parties de votre corps ne sont pas visibles. Reculez un peu.
strings.hold_grace_period: L'instructeur est passé à la suite, mais pas d'inquiétude — prenez le temps d'entrer dans {pose_name}. Il vous reste environ {breaths} cycles respiratoires.
strings.hold_release: Pas de problème — suivons l'instructeur. On pratiquera {pose_name} la prochaine fois.
strings.correction_0: Fléchissez davantage votre genou gauche — enfoncez votre poids dedans.
strings.correction_1: Le genou gauche est trop droit — assouplissez-le et laissez les hanches descendre.
strings.correction_2: Votre jambe gauche a besoin de plus de flexion — dirigez ce genou sur vos orteils.
strings.correction_3: Guerrier Deux vit dans les jambes — enfoncez ce genou gauche directement au-dessus de votre cheville.
strings.correction_4: Left knee wants to go deeper — this is where your strength lives.
strings.correction_5: Sit into that left knee — imagine lowering into a chair.
strings.correction_6: Left knee just a touch deeper — breathe and let gravity help.
strings.correction_7: Drop your left knee lower — press the floor away with your heel.
strings.correction_8: In this lunge, the front knee tracks right over your ankle — go deeper.
strings.correction_9: Redressez votre jambe gauche — appuyez fermement le talon dans le sol.
strings.correction_10: Left knee is bent too far — draw back and stack the knee over the heel.
strings.correction_11: Extend your left leg — engage the thigh and lengthen through the knee.
strings.correction_12: En Chien tête en bas la jambe arrière est longue — pressez votre talon gauche vers le tapis.
strings.correction_13: Left leg needs more length — activate the quad and press out.
strings.correction_14: Micro-straighten the left knee — just ease the bend slightly.
strings.correction_15: Fléchissez davantage votre genou droit — laissez les hanches descendre.
strings.correction_16: Your right leg is too straight — soften the knee and sit lower.
strings.correction_17: Right knee needs more bend — track it forward over your middle toe.
strings.correction_18: Sink into your right knee — this is the powerhouse of this pose.
strings.correction_19: Right knee just a little deeper — use your breath to soften into it.
strings.correction_20: Front knee bends to ninety — keep pressing that right knee forward.
strings.correction_21: Redressez votre jambe droite — activez les muscles de la cuisse.
strings.correction_22: Right knee is over-bent — ease back and stack it over your foot.
strings.correction_23: Press your right heel down and let the leg lengthen naturally.
strings.correction_24: Right leg wants more extension — imagine the knee opening up.
strings.correction_25: That back leg is your anchor — press the right heel and lengthen.
strings.correction_26: Fléchissez les deux genoux également — abaissez les hanches avec contrôle.
strings.correction_27: Drop your weight through both legs — equal depth in each knee.
strings.correction_28: Both knees want more bend — this is a squat, commit to it.
strings.correction_29: Straighten both legs — press both heels down and lengthen.
strings.correction_30: Both legs can extend more — fire the quads and feel the length.
strings.correction_31: Open your left hip — let it rotate outward gently.
strings.correction_32: Your left hip is too closed — rotate it open and give it space.
strings.correction_33: Left hip needs more external rotation — let it spiral outward.
strings.correction_34: In this pose your left hip opens to the side — allow that rotation.
strings.correction_35: Left hip is restricted — breathe in and let it release outward.
strings.correction_36: Square your left hip forward — draw it back toward center.
strings.correction_37: Left hip is swinging open — bring it forward and stack it.
strings.correction_38: Pull your left hip in — imagine headlights facing forward.
strings.correction_39: Left hip rotates inward here — close it down slightly.
strings.correction_40: Open your right hip — rotate it out and let it breathe.
strings.correction_41: Right hip needs to open outward — allow the rotation.
strings.correction_42: Let your right hip externally rotate — imagine it turning like a door hinge.
strings.correction_43: Square your right hip — draw it forward to match the left.
strings.correction_44: Right hip is drifting open — bring it forward and level your pelvis.
strings.correction_45: Rotate your right hip inward just a touch — settle it.
strings.correction_46: Level your hips — both sides even, pelvis neutral.
strings.correction_47: Your hips are uneven — work to square them and find balance.
strings.correction_48: Hips want to melt down and back — let gravity pull them toward the heels.
strings.correction_49: Levez votre bras gauche — balancez-le vers le haut et tendez les doigts.
strings.correction_50: Left arm is dropping — raise it to shoulder height and hold.
strings.correction_51: Float your left arm upward — there's more space to extend into.
strings.correction_52: Left arm needs to be parallel to the floor — extend it out level.
strings.correction_53: Arms in Warrior Two are wings — your left arm is falling, spread it wide.
strings.correction_54: Reach your left arm overhead — full extension through the wrist.
strings.correction_55: Baissez votre bras gauche — laissez-le se relâcher sur votre côté.
strings.correction_56: Your left arm is too high — ease it down and soften the shoulder.
strings.correction_57: Release the left shoulder down — unshrug it and let it drop.
strings.correction_58: Left shoulder is creeping up — draw the blade down your back.
strings.correction_59: Levez votre bras droit — tendez-le complètement.
strings.correction_60: Right arm needs height — sweep it up and hold it there.
strings.correction_61: Your right arm is dropping below the line — lift it level.
strings.correction_62: Sweep your right arm overhead — full reach from shoulder to fingertip.
strings.correction_63: Baissez votre bras droit — laissez l'épaule s'assouplir.
strings.correction_64: Right arm is too elevated — ease it down without collapsing the shape.
strings.correction_65: Release your right shoulder — slide the blade down and let the arm rest.
strings.correction_66: Sweep both arms up — reach them high overhead.
strings.correction_67: Both arms need to lift — raise them together, even and strong.
strings.correction_68: Both arms spread to the sides — like wings at shoulder height.
strings.correction_69: Release both shoulders — let them melt away from your ears.
strings.correction_70: Draw both shoulder blades down your back — create length in the neck.
strings.correction_71: Extend your left arm — press out through the heel of your hand.
strings.correction_72: Your left elbow is bent — lengthen through the arm.
strings.correction_73: Left arm needs more extension — straighten it without locking the joint.
strings.correction_74: Reach through your left fingertips — let the arm lengthen fully.
strings.correction_75: Assouplissez votre coude gauche — laissez-y une légère flexion.
strings.correction_76: Your left arm is locking out — add a micro-bend to protect the joint.
strings.correction_77: Release the hyper-extension in your left arm — ease the elbow slightly.
strings.correction_78: Straighten your right arm — extend it fully from shoulder to wrist.
strings.correction_79: Your right elbow is folding — press through the hand and lengthen.
strings.correction_80: Right arm needs more extension — reach it a little further.
strings.correction_81: Assouplissez le coude droit — une micro-flexion protège l'articulation.
strings.correction_82: Right arm is over-extending — ease the elbow, don't force it straight.
strings.correction_83: Let your right elbow have a natural soft bend — it doesn't need to lock.
strings.correction_84: Both arms need more extension — press out through both hands.
strings.correction_85: Soften both elbows — let a gentle bend live in each arm.
strings.correction_86: Repoussez le sol — en Chien tête en bas, la poussée vient des mains.
strings.correction_87: Hips drive upward in Down Dog — lift them high and back.
strings.correction_88: Pedal your heels toward the mat — one at a time, working toward the floor.
strings.correction_89: Press the floor away and lift your chest — open the heart forward.
strings.correction_90: Keep your elbows drawing in toward the ribs — cobra arms hug the body.
strings.correction_91: Extend through the arms in Upward Dog — straighten them fully.
strings.correction_92: Standing leg is your trunk — keep that left knee firm and straight.
strings.correction_93: In Tree your arms are branches — sweep them up and let them grow.
strings.correction_94: Plank is a straight line from head to heel — engage your core.
strings.correction_95: Press the floor away in Plank — arms straight, no sag in the hips.
strings.correction_96: Faites fondre les hanches vers les talons — abandonnez-vous complètement.
strings.correction_97: Arms reach long in Child's Pose — walk your fingertips forward.
strings.correction_98: In Seated Forward Fold, lead with your chest — hinge from the hips, not the back.
strings.correction_99: Legs are active in this fold — engage your quads and flex your feet.
strings.correction_100: La Montagne est un calme actif — appuyez les deux pieds et tenez-vous grand.
strings.correction_101: In Mountain, arms rest alongside the body — soften them down.
strings.correction_102: In Triangle, back leg is straight and strong — press that heel into the mat.
strings.correction_103: Top arm reaches to the sky in Triangle — extend it fully from the hip.
strings.correction_104: Standing leg is straight and strong in Warrior Three — lock that knee.
strings.correction_105: Arms reach forward in Warrior Three — extend them long past your ears.
strings.correction_106: Bend both knees and raise your arms — find those two movements at once.
strings.correction_107: Ground through the legs while you extend the arms — rooted and reaching.
strings.correction_108: Open the front hip while squaring the back — find that opposing rotation.
strings.correction_109: Respirez vers la résistance et laissez-la s'assouplir à l'expiration.
strings.correction_110: Presque là — encore un souffle et faites cet ajustement final.
strings.correction_111: Restez avec ça — le corps prend un moment pour arriver dans ces formes.
strings.correction_112: Left knee tracks over the second toe — aim for that alignment.
strings.correction_113: Right knee tracks over the second toe — find that precision.
strings.correction_114: Ground through your left heel — the back leg is your foundation.
strings.correction_115: Press your right heel into the mat — feel the energy travel up the leg.
strings.correction_116: Neutral pelvis — neither tilting forward nor tucking under.
strings.correction_117: Tuck your tailbone — bring length to the lower back.
strings.correction_118: Lift through the back of your left knee — quadricep engaged.
strings.correction_119: Soften your right knee — not every pose wants a locked leg.
strings.correction_120: Your left shoulder is climbing — consciously release it away from your ear.
strings.correction_121: Right shoulder is tense — let it drop and create space in your neck.
strings.correction_122: Left arm is the compass — extend it fully and it guides the whole pose.
strings.correction_123: Right arm reaches back with intention — don't let it wilt.
strings.correction_124: Feel the length from your left hip to your left fingertips.
strings.correction_125: Right side of the body is long — reach from hip to fingertip.
strings.correction_126: Micro-bend your left elbow — it's for joint safety, not a big movement.
strings.correction_127: Micro-bend your right elbow — protective, not visible from the outside.
strings.correction_128: Both hips are level here — don't let either side hike up.
strings.correction_129: Hip crease deepens as you sink — allow that.
strings.correction_130: The whole left side is one line — knee, hip, shoulder, aligned.
strings.correction_131: Major adjustment needed — left knee is way off, bring it right over the ankle.
strings.correction_132: Big correction right knee — it needs much more bend, drop your hips significantly.
strings.correction_133: Left arm is completely down — you need to lift it fully to shoulder height.
strings.correction_134: Hips are far from the target — lower significantly and open wide.
strings.correction_135: Almost perfect on the left knee — just a touch more depth.
strings.correction_136: Right knee is spot on — minor refinement, track it slightly more forward.
strings.correction_137: Left shoulder just slightly low — barely lift it.
strings.correction_138: Right shoulder is a fraction high — ease it down imperceptibly.
strings.correction_139: Tiny adjustment — left hip wants just a little more opening.
strings.correction_140: Micro-adjustment right hip — draw it forward the smallest amount.
strings.step_mountain_0: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
strings.step_mountain_1: Press all four corners of your feet firmly into the ground.
strings.step_mountain_2: Engage your thighs and lift your kneecaps slightly.
strings.step_mountain_3: Lengthen your tailbone down and lift your chest.
strings.step_mountain_4: Relax your shoulders away from your ears, arms at your sides.
strings.step_mountain_5: Breathe steadily and hold for five to ten breaths.
strings.step_forward_fold_2: Exhale and hinge forward from your hips.
strings.step_forward_fold_3: Let your hands hang toward the floor or hold your elbows.
strings.step_forward_fold_4: Bend your knees generously if your hamstrings are tight.
strings.step_forward_fold_5: Relax your head and neck completely.
strings.step_forward_fold_6: Hold for five breaths, deepening with each exhale.
strings.step_halfway_lift_0: From Forward Fold, place your hands on your shins.
strings.step_halfway_lift_1: Inhale and lift your chest halfway up.
strings.step_halfway_lift_2: Make your back as flat as a tabletop.
strings.step_halfway_lift_3: Draw your shoulder blades together and down.
strings.step_halfway_lift_4: Keep your neck in line with your spine.
strings.step_halfway_lift_5: Hold for one breath before moving on.
strings.step_warrior_i_0: Step your left foot back about three to four feet.
strings.step_warrior_i_1: Turn your left foot out to about forty-five degrees.
strings.step_warrior_i_2: Bend your right knee directly over your right ankle.
strings.step_warrior_i_3: Square your hips to face the front of your mat.
strings.step_warrior_i_4: Inhale and raise both arms straight overhead.
strings.step_warrior_i_5: Draw your shoulder blades down your back.
strings.step_warrior_i_6: Gaze forward or slightly upward and hold for five breaths.
strings.step_warrior_ii_0: Step your feet wide apart, about four feet.
strings.step_warrior_ii_1: Turn your right foot out ninety degrees, left foot in slightly.
strings.step_warrior_ii_2: Bend your right knee to ninety degrees over your ankle.
strings.step_warrior_ii_3: Extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height — palms down.
strings.step_warrior_ii_4: Keep your torso directly over your hips, not leaning forward.
strings.step_warrior_ii_5: Turn your head to gaze over your right fingertips.
strings.step_warrior_ii_6: Hold for five steady breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_warrior_iii_0: Begin standing on your right foot.
strings.step_warrior_iii_1: Hinge forward at your hip, lifting your left leg behind you.
strings.step_warrior_iii_2: Reach your torso and left leg parallel to the floor.
strings.step_warrior_iii_3: Extend your arms forward or keep them by your sides.
strings.step_warrior_iii_4: Flex your raised foot and keep your hips level.
strings.step_warrior_iii_5: Hold for three to five breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_chair_1: Inhale and raise your arms straight overhead.
strings.step_chair_2: Exhale and bend your knees, lowering your hips as if sitting.
strings.step_chair_3: Bring your thighs as parallel to the floor as comfortable.
strings.step_chair_4: Keep your knees over your toes.
strings.step_chair_5: Draw your lower belly in and lengthen your spine.
strings.step_tree_0: Shift your weight onto your left foot.
strings.step_tree_1: Bend your right knee and place your right foot on your inner left thigh.
strings.step_tree_2: Press foot and thigh against each other for stability.
strings.step_tree_3: Bring your palms together at your chest or raise arms overhead.
strings.step_tree_4: Fix your gaze on a steady point in front of you.
strings.step_tree_5: Hold for five breaths, then repeat on the other side.
strings.step_triangle_0: Step your feet wide apart, about three to four feet.
strings.step_triangle_1: Turn your right foot out ninety degrees.
strings.step_triangle_2: Extend both arms out to the sides.
strings.step_triangle_3: Reach your right hand toward your right shin.
strings.step_triangle_4: Stack your left arm directly above your right.
strings.step_triangle_5: Keep both legs straight and your torso long.
strings.step_triangle_6: Gaze up toward your raised hand. Hold five breaths.
strings.step_downward_dog_1: Tuck your toes and press your hips up and back.
strings.step_downward_dog_2: Straighten your legs as much as comfortable.
strings.step_downward_dog_3: Press your hands firmly into the mat, fingers spread wide.
strings.step_downward_dog_4: Let your head hang between your upper arms.
strings.step_downward_dog_5: Draw your navel toward your spine.
strings.step_downward_dog_6: Hold for five to ten breaths.
strings.step_plank_0: Begin on your hands and knees.
strings.step_plank_1: Step both feet back so your body forms a straight line.
strings.step_plank_2: Stack your wrists directly under your shoulders.
strings.step_plank_3: Engage your core — draw your belly button toward your spine.
strings.step_plank_4: Keep your hips level — not sagging or piking up.
strings.step_plank_5: Press through your heels and gaze slightly forward.
strings.step_low_lunge_0: Step your right foot forward between your hands.
strings.step_low_lunge_1: Lower your left knee to the mat.
strings.step_low_lunge_2: Sink your hips forward and down.
strings.step_low_lunge_3: Inhale and raise your arms overhead.
strings.step_low_lunge_4: Draw your shoulder blades down and open your chest.
strings.step_low_lunge_5: Hold for five breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_high_lunge_0: Step your right foot forward, keeping the back leg straight.
strings.step_high_lunge_1: Bend your right knee to ninety degrees.
strings.step_high_lunge_3: Inhale and raise both arms overhead.
strings.step_high_lunge_4: Square your hips forward as much as possible.
strings.step_high_lunge_5: Hold for five breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_cobra_0: Lie face down with legs extended behind you.
strings.step_cobra_1: Place your palms flat under your shoulders.
strings.step_cobra_2: Press the tops of your feet into the mat.
strings.step_cobra_3: Inhale and slowly lift your chest.
strings.step_cobra_4: Keep your elbows slightly bent and close to your sides.
strings.step_cobra_5: Roll your shoulders back and open your chest.
strings.step_cobra_6: Hold for five breaths, then slowly lower down.
strings.step_upward_dog_0: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
strings.step_upward_dog_1: Press firmly into your hands and straighten your arms.
strings.step_upward_dog_2: Lift your thighs and knees off the mat.
strings.step_upward_dog_3: Roll your shoulders back and lift your chest high.
strings.step_upward_dog_4: Press the tops of your feet into the mat.
strings.step_upward_dog_5: Hold for one to three breaths.
strings.step_child_0: Kneel on the mat with your big toes touching.
strings.step_child_1: Sit back on your heels and open your knees hip-width apart.
strings.step_child_2: Exhale and fold your torso forward between your thighs.
strings.step_child_3: Extend your arms forward on the mat, palms facing down.
strings.step_child_4: Rest your forehead gently on the mat.
strings.step_child_6: Rest here for five to ten breaths.
strings.step_seated_forward_0: Sit with both legs extended straight in front of you.
strings.step_seated_forward_1: Flex your feet, pressing through your heels.
strings.step_seated_forward_2: Inhale and lengthen your spine, raising arms overhead.
strings.step_seated_forward_3: Exhale and hinge forward from your hips.
strings.step_seated_forward_4: Reach toward your shins, ankles, or feet.
strings.step_seated_forward_5: Keep your spine long rather than rounding your back.
strings.step_seated_forward_6: Hold for five to eight breaths.
strings.step_cat_cow_0: Come onto your hands and knees — wrists under shoulders, knees under hips.
strings.step_cat_cow_1: For Cow: inhale, drop your belly, lift your chest and tailbone.
strings.step_cat_cow_2: For Cat: exhale, round your spine up toward the ceiling.
strings.step_cat_cow_3: Tuck your chin to your chest and your tailbone under.
strings.step_cat_cow_4: Move slowly, linking each movement to your breath.
strings.step_cat_cow_5: Continue for five to ten cycles.
